lines.en: label undeservedfuture11:
scene beachhimawalk1
: Oh. That was quick.
lines.zh: : 哦。还挺快的。

lines.en: : Told you it was a convenient power! Just one more perk of being a time-janitor.
lines.zh: : 都说了这能力很方便嘛！这只是当「时间清洁工」的又一项额外福利。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk2
: You really need to come up with a different name for-
lines.zh: : 你真该给这活儿换个名字——

lines.en: : Why are you still wearing that?
lines.zh: : 你怎么还穿着那身？

lines.en: : It’s surprisingly comfy. I don’t blame your friend one bit for looking so tired all the time.
lines.zh: : 意外地挺舒服的。我一点都不怪你那位朋友，难怪她整天看起来都那么累。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk3
: So, like...how much of my life do you watch exactly? Because, whatever the amount may be, I’d appreciate it if you could drop it down to zero from this point on.
lines.zh: : 那么，比如说……你到底看了我人生中的多少部分？因为不管有多少，我希望从现在起你能把它降到零。

lines.en: : No can do, buckaroo. I need to stay in the loop, pun not intended, to make sure things don’t get too messed up since they could directly impact my continued existence.
lines.zh: : 办不到，小牛仔。我必须保持在信息圈里——这不是双关——好确保事情不会乱得太离谱，因为它们会直接影响到我能否继续存在。

lines.en: : Sorry, are things not already “too messed up?” Because they seem pretty fucking messed up, Himawari.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，事情难道还算不上「太离谱」吗？因为在我看来已经他妈的乱得不能再乱了，Himawari。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, you live in a world that’s essentially just a side-effect of your imaginary friend’s imaginary desires. Of course something like that wouldn’t be stable when it technically shouldn’t exist at all.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你活在一个本质上只是你那位想象中的朋友的、想象中的欲望的副产物的世界里。这种东西本来就不该存在，当然不可能稳定。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk4
: Calling her an “imaginary friend” is a little reductive, don’t you think? She still thinks. She still feels. And I’m almost positive she has no idea about what she is if what you say is true.
lines.zh: : 把她叫成「想象中的朋友」是不是有点太轻描淡写了？她会思考。她也会感受。而且如果你说的都是真的，我几乎可以肯定她根本不知道自己是什么。

lines.en: : Why would she? Assuming you’re the only fake person in a sea of real ones is something so depressing and weird that I don’t even think you could do it. And you do all sorts of weird stuff.
lines.zh: : 她怎么会知道呢？「在一群真人当中，只有你是假的」这种假设太让人沮丧、也太诡异了，我甚至觉得你自己都做不到。而你可是各种诡异的事都干得出来。

lines.en: : Maybe here I do. It’s hard not to when you’re surrounded by...equally weird shit. I was normal in Aomori, though. At least...comparatively.
lines.zh: : 也许在这儿确实如此。当你周围全是……同样诡异的破事时，很难不这样。不过在 Aomori 的时候我还算正常。至少……相对而言。

lines.en: : I think you’re a little weirdo who’s never been normal anywhere. But yeah, I think I get what you’re saying.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你就是个在哪儿都没正常过的小怪人。不过嘛，我大概明白你的意思。

lines.en: : Do you, like...remember any of it? Or is everything that happened just...
lines.zh: : 你……还记得那些事吗？还是发生过的一切就只是……

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk5
: Hm? Of course I remember it. I brought up the purikura booths, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 嗯？我当然记得啊。我不是提过大头贴机的事吗？

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk6
: But...how? You erased that Himawari, didn’t you? I assumed everything just...went with her.
lines.zh: : 可是……怎么做到的？你不是把那个 Himawari 抹掉了吗？我以为一切都……跟着她一起没了。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk7
: Nope! All up here. Every last minute of it. That’s how I set it up.
lines.zh: : 才没有！全在这儿。每一分钟都在。我就是这么安排的。

lines.en: : Set it up?...
: Think of the Himawari in Aomori as a solar panel and me as the battery. She collects memories and I absorb them. It’d be hard to do my job if that wasn’t the case.
lines.zh: : 把 Aomori 的那个 Himawari 想象成太阳能板，我就是蓄电池。她收集记忆，我来吸收。如果不是这样，我这活儿可干不下去。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk8
: There will be more soon too.
lines.zh: : 很快还会再多一些。

lines.en: : More...Himawaris?
lines.zh: : 更多的……Himawari？

lines.en: : Yup! I’m still trying to work out the kinks, but I have big plans for the future. I want solar panels everywhere. Don’t tell anybody I told you that, though. It’s a secret.
lines.zh: : 对啊！我还在摸索解决各种小毛病，但我对未来有大计划。我想让太阳能板遍布各地。不过别跟别人说是我告诉你的。这是秘密。

lines.en: : But...I thought you said we only get one wish and Aomori was yours? Do you...get another now that it’s been destroyed?
lines.zh: : 可是……你不是说过我们只有一个愿望，而 Aomori 就是你的那个吗？现在它被毁了，你……还能再得一个？

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk9
: It’s not destroyed at all. It’ll start over soon with a new me and a new you who wound up there due to fate or choice or whatever it is that leads people anywhere.
lines.zh: : 它根本没被毁掉。很快就会重新开始，换上一个新的我和一个新的你——因为命运也好、选择也好，随便什么把人带到那儿的东西，都会让你们在那里重来一遍。

lines.en: : Just because you had to witness the fall of one due to my colossal mix-up doesn’t mean there aren’t millions of other Aomoris out there born from someone else’s wishes.
lines.zh: : 你只是因为我的巨大失误而不得不目睹其中一个崩塌，并不意味着不存在成千上万个由别人的愿望诞生的 Aomori。

lines.en: : That’s why it took me so long to find you. I didn’t realize you were there at all for the first two months.
lines.zh: : 这也是我花了这么久才找到你的原因。头两个月我完全没意识到你在那儿。

lines.en: : I was, like...seriously freaking out. And it only got worse once I figured out what happened since I knew taking you back would break both of your hearts.
lines.zh: : 我当时……真的是慌得不行。等我弄明白发生了什么之后就更糟了，因为我知道把你带回去会伤透你们两个人的心。

lines.en: : You’re surprisingly fine, though. Do you actually not love me at all?
lines.zh: : 不过你倒是意外地没事。你其实根本一点都不爱我吗？

lines.en: : Of course I do. I’m just still trying to understand the...logistics of this place.
lines.zh: : 我当然爱。我只是还在努力理解这个地方的……运作机制。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk10
: We call it the Wishing Well. For reasons I’m sure you can figure out on your own. And yeah, it’s hard to ever really understand it without zooming out to see the big picture.
lines.zh: : 我们叫它「许愿井」。原因我相信你自己能想明白。而且没错，不把视角拉远看到全局，是很难真正理解它的。

lines.en: : I know when I was first starting out, it helped me to think about it like the stars. Just a big ole’ scatter plot but without any logic or reason to it, with each star being a different world.
lines.zh: : 我知道我刚开始的时候，把它想象成星星会有帮助。就像一张巨大的散点图，只是毫无逻辑和道理可言，每一颗星都是一个不同的世界。

lines.en: : We have names and classifications for all of them, just as we do the gods themselves. But with more popping up or fizzling out every day, it’s definitely overwhelming at times.
lines.zh: : 我们给所有世界都起了名字、做了分类，就像我们给那些神本身做的一样。但每天都有新的出现、旧的消散，确实有时候会让人招架不住。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk11
: We are extremely understaffed too. You’d think the organization literally pulling the levers that guide humanity would have its shit together, but nope. Just as chaotic as any other megacorp.
lines.zh: : 我们的人手也严重不足。你大概以为这个真正在拨动引导人类的操纵杆的组织会很有条理，但并没有。跟其他任何巨型企业一样混乱。

lines.en: : How did you even get involved in any of this? I don’t understand. You seemed so...normal and...almost directionless just yesterday.
lines.zh: : 你到底是怎么卷进这些事的？我不明白。你昨天看起来还那么……普通，而且……几乎毫无方向感。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk12
: I am sorry, but that information is classified. I am unable to disclose the specifics of our recruitment program.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉，但这段信息属于机密。我无法透露我们招募计划的具体内容。

lines.en: : Just know that only the best of the best are selected. To which I am a clear choice, as I’m sure you’d agree.
lines.zh: : 你只要知道，只有最优秀的人才会被选中就够了。而我显然是其中之选，这点我相信你也会同意。

lines.en: : Yeah...just a little surprised to see you’re still hiding information from me. I assumed “origins of the world” would be a little higher on the classified priority list than your hiring process.
lines.zh: : 是吗……只是看到你还在对我隐瞒信息，我有点意外。我以为「世界的起源」在你的机密优先级列表里，会比你的招聘流程排得靠前一点。

lines.en: : You have clearly never worked for a megacorp.
lines.zh: : 你显然从没在巨型企业里干过活。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk13
: That said! I will answer any question I find directly relevant to your mission of escaping from this place to reunite with me under happier circumstances.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此！任何我认为与你的任务——逃离这里、在更幸福的境况下与我重聚——直接相关的问题，我都会回答。

lines.en: : Then, could you at least tell me what your “home world” is like? The one where the original you is from? Because the fact that you needed to wish for a better world at all is-
lines.zh: : 那么，你至少能告诉我你的「原属世界」是什么样的吗？就是原本的你来自的那个世界？因为你需要许愿要一个更好的世界这件事本身就——

lines.en: : Indicative that things weren’t perfect there, right?
lines.zh: : 说明那边并不完美，对吧？

lines.en: : Like, maybe there was a real apocalypse that killed you and mom and pulled me into all of this? Or maybe I just wasn’t as cute there and needed to create a world in which I was?
lines.zh: : 比如说，也许真的有一场末日夺走了你和妈妈，把我卷进了这一切？或者只是因为我在那边不够可爱，才需要创造一个我可爱的世界？

lines.en: : Are you just going to answer my question with other rhetorical questions or do you have an actual response?
lines.zh: : 你是打算一直用别的反问来回答我的问题，还是有个真正的答案？

lines.en: : I’ll need more time for that one, if that’s okay. I need to be careful about what I say to you since I don’t want to negatively influence your actions from this point on.
lines.zh: : 这个问题我需要更多时间，可以吗？我得小心对你说的话，因为我不想从现在开始对你的行动产生负面影响。

lines.en: : So you won’t answer anything directly relevant. Just positively relevant.
lines.zh: : 所以直接相关的你都不会回答。只有正面相关的才会。

lines.en: : We have less than twenty four hours together and you’re going to waste it on pedantry?
lines.zh: : 我们在一起的时间不到二十四小时，你打算把它浪费在咬文嚼字上？

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk14
: That’s all?...
lines.zh: : 就这么点时间吗？...

lines.en: : Yeah...
: You didn’t think this would last forever, did you?
lines.zh: : 你不会以为这会永远持续下去吧？

lines.en: : No, but...I wanted more than a day at least. Ayane isn’t even able to-
lines.zh: : 没有，可是……我至少想要比一天更多。Ayane 甚至还不能——

lines.en: : We’ll have plenty of time someday, but...
lines.zh: : 我们总有一天会有大把时间的，但是……

lines.en: : Today is not that day. I still have a job to do. And so do you.
lines.zh: : 今天不是那一天。我还有工作要做。你也是。

lines.en: : If we’re not able to put our feelings aside, we’ll never get you out of here. And that’s something that absolutely needs to happen if we’re ever going to meet again.
lines.zh: : 如果我们没法把感情搁到一边，就永远没办法把你弄出去。而如果我们还想再见面的话，这件事绝对必须发生。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk15
: Hah...
: On the bright side, we got to spend four whole months together. And they were the best four months I’ve had in a very long time.
lines.zh: : 往好的方面想，我们毕竟一起度过了整整四个月。那是我很久以来过得最好的四个月。

lines.en: : They were the best four months I’ve ever had. I don’t know how I’m supposed to just...go back to normal after this.
lines.zh: : 那是我这辈子过得最好的四个月。我不知道这之后要怎么……回到正常的生活。

lines.en: : You can always change what “normal” is. And you probably should too since you’ve been pretty unhelpful concerning your own rescue mission.
lines.zh: : 「正常」是什么，你随时都可以重新定义。而且你大概也该这么做，因为在你自己的营救任务上，你一直挺帮倒忙的。

lines.en: : Yeah, well we’ll see how effective I am now that I’m also aware the girl I’ve been hung up on forever can’t exist in the same world as me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那我们就看看我现在能有多大用处——毕竟我还刚知道，我惦记了一辈子的那个女孩，根本没法跟我存在于同一个世界。

lines.en: : It’s tougher than it sounds. And it sounds pretty tough to begin with, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这比听起来还要难。而它本来就够难了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...tough is an understatement.
lines.zh: : 是啊……「难」这个词都说轻了。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk16
: What’s the plan now, then? You mentioned something about, uhh...reformatting people?
lines.zh: : 那么现在计划是什么？你提过什么……格式化人？

lines.en: : Think of what you saw back in Aomori, just on a smaller and sometimes, uhh...different scale.
lines.zh: : 想想你在 Aomori 看到的那些，只是规模更小，而且有时候……呃……形式不太一样。

lines.en: : Different how? Because I kept it together, but what I saw back up north was haunting and I’d prefer to not see it again if I don’t have to.
lines.zh: : 不一样在哪儿？因为我在北方看到的东西虽然我扛住了，但那画面一直缠着我，如果可以的话我不想再看第二次。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk17
: I warned you it wouldn’t be pretty, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我警告过你那不会好看的，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but that could mean anything.
lines.zh: : 是警告过，可那什么都可能意味着。

lines.en: : It’s precisely because it could mean anything that it won’t be pretty.
lines.zh: : 正因为什么都可能意味着，所以才不会好看。

lines.en: : The end of the world doesn’t just come and go for everyone. People fight back sometimes. Like cornered animals finally understanding the gravity of the threat they face.
lines.zh: : 世界末日不是对所有人来说都来了又走的。有时候人们会反抗。就像被困住的动物终于明白了它们面临的威胁有多严重。

lines.en: : Fight back...how? Against the world itself?
lines.zh: : 反抗……怎么反抗？反抗世界本身？

lines.en: : Depends on what they see. Or what they think they see. But most of the time, they just turn into dolls.
lines.zh: : 取决于他们看到了什么。或者他们以为自己看到了什么。但大多数时候，他们只是变成人偶。

lines.en: : Dolls?
lines.zh: : 人偶？

lines.en: : Limp and lifeless. Glassy eyes and skin that’s cold to the touch. Just they aren’t actually lifeless in most cases. They’re sort of just...dormant. Waiting for the world to start turning again.
lines.zh: : 瘫软、毫无生气。眼神空洞，皮肤摸上去是冷的。只是大多数情况下他们并非真的没有生气。他们有点像……休眠了。等着世界重新开始转动。

lines.en: : And...the one’s who aren’t like that? What becomes of them?
lines.zh: : 那……不像那样的那些人呢？他们会变成什么？

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk18
: Shi-chan normally. Or any other specialist.
lines.zh: : 通常是 Shi 酱。或者其他专员。

lines.en: : Your friend?
lines.zh: : 你朋友？

lines.en: : Careful. I don’t want her to hear me call her that and she might be waiting around here somewhere.
lines.zh: : 小声点。我可不想让她听见我这么叫她，她说不定就在附近哪儿藏着。

lines.en: : The specialists are the ones who take care of the bodies who need restoring, though. They typically require a little extra work to prevent them from going haywire again.
lines.zh: : 不过负责处理那些需要修复的身体的，就是专员们。他们通常需要多费点功夫，防止她们再次失控。

lines.en: : Himawari, if these are girls I care about, I don’t want to see them-
lines.zh: : Himawari，如果那是我关心的女孩，我不想去看到她们——

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk19
: Keep your eyes on me if it makes you more comfortable. I don’t want you to have to see stuff like that either.
lines.zh: : 如果盯着我能让你好受点，就盯着我看吧。我也不想让你看到那种东西。

lines.en: : I’m used to it now, but I’d be lying if I didn’t say it ruined many a day for me back in the beginning.
lines.zh: : 我现在已经习惯了，但要说一开始那些没毁掉我好多天的心情，那是在撒谎。

lines.en: : It can still be scary, I admit. But I’m a little less scared knowing you’re with me. So please don’t chicken out.
lines.zh: : 我承认，有时候还是会害怕。不过知道你在我身边，我就没那么怕了。所以请千万别临阵退缩。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk20
: I’m in it for the long haul at this point. Just don’t hold it against me if the sight of blood triggers the same trauma that likely snowballed into this universe spawning in the first place-
lines.zh: : 到这个地步我已经是走到底了。只是如果见到血触发了当初可能滚雪球般催生出这个宇宙的那段创伤，你可别怪我——

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk21
: AAAAAHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : What is it? You don’t see someone from school, do-
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你不会是看到了学校里的人吧——

lines.en: : RABBIT!
lines.zh: : 兔子！

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk22
: Sorry. Did I say “rabbit?” I meant Sana.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我刚才说「兔子」了吗？我是想说 Sana。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I understood the callback.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我听懂那个梗了。

lines.en: : She really is just...limp, huh?
lines.zh: : 她真的就只是……瘫在那儿啊。

lines.en: : She was probably hanging out over here when time stopped and just plopped over. That’s how it goes most of the time, to be honest. Just one more reason we call them dolls.
lines.zh: : 时间停止的时候她大概就在这附近晃悠，然后直接倒下了。说实话大多数时候就是这样。这也是我们叫她们人偶的又一个原因。

lines.en: : What now then?
lines.zh: : 那现在怎么办？

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk23
: Now, you get a behind-the-scenes peek at how all of the girls you know have their memories and perceptions altered any time the world reboots.
lines.zh: : 现在，你可以幕后参观一下，每当世界重启时，你认识的那些女生的记忆和认知是怎么被改写的。

lines.en: : Think of it like a virus scan, but for humans instead of computers. We purge them of information that might make the world less stable and make sure that all the interpersonal stuff stays.
lines.zh: : 把它想象成病毒扫描，只不过对象是活人而不是电脑。我们清除掉那些可能让世界变得不稳定的信息，同时确保人际关系的部分保留下来。

lines.en: : We refresh their inhibitors too, which is what keeps most of them from ever catching onto the fact that they’re living in a fabricated reality at all.
lines.zh: : 我们也会刷新她们的抑制剂，正是它让大多数人永远不会察觉自己其实活在一个伪造的现实里。

lines.en: : And the reason I say “most of them” is because girls in this world are actually catching on for some reason.
lines.zh: : 而我之所以说「大多数人」，是因为这个世界里的女孩们不知为何正在察觉。

lines.en: : Does that not happen in other worlds? Does everyone just stay oblivious?
lines.zh: : 别的世界不会发生这种事吗？大家都一直懵懂无知？

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk24
: Most of the time, yeah. People are so afraid of death that like 95%% of the worlds generated via wishes involve an infinite timeline. So dealing with this is super common, all things considered.
lines.zh: : 大多数时候，是的。人们太害怕死亡了，所以大概有 95%% 由愿望生成的世界都带有无限的时间线。所以综合来看，处理这种事其实相当常见。

lines.en: : We’ve had people become somewhat “aware” in the past when it comes to other worlds. Never on this scale, though, with multiple people gaining awareness at the same time.
lines.zh: : 过去在其他世界里，也有人变得有点「察觉」。但从没有过这种规模——多个人同时获得觉察。

lines.en: : Most timelines are much longer too. And while there are definitely a good number of “forever young” aspirants out there, their worlds aren’t typically restricted to just a single school year.
lines.zh: : 大多数时间线也长得多。虽然确实有不少「永葆青春」的向往者，但她们的世界通常不会被限制在单独一个学年里。

lines.en: : In the grand scheme of things, basically everything about this world makes it look like a repeatedly malfunctioning version of a typical wish. Which is likely because-
lines.zh: : 从大局来看，这个世界的一切基本上都让它看起来像一个反复出故障的典型愿望版本。这很可能是因为——

lines.en: : Because it comes from Maya and not someone “real.”
lines.zh: : 因为它是来自 Maya，而不是某个「真实」的人。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk25
: Good job, Dad! You’re so smart! I’m so proud of you!
lines.zh: : 干得好，爸爸！你太聪明了！我真为你骄傲！

lines.en: : Thank you. I will ignore the very obvious sarcasm and take these words to heart. I have uncovered the secrets of the world and am now ready to leave.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我会无视那明摆着的讽刺，把这些话记在心里。我已经揭开了世界的秘密，现在准备离开了。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk26
: It’s this stuff that ultimately caught the attention of the higher-ups in the first place and led to them realizing what this place is.
lines.zh: : 正是这些异常最终引起了上层的注意，才让他们意识到这个地方是什么。

lines.en: : A world that, in itself, is a bit of a virus. Or perhaps even a bootleg since it’s clearly based on the world you brought Maya into.
lines.zh: : 一个本身就是某种病毒的世界。或者甚至可以说是盗版，因为它显然是基于你把 Maya 带入的那个世界。

lines.en: : Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : Then, could she continue to exist if we get back to that world? The one where she exists but this place doesn’t?
lines.zh: : 那么，如果我们能回到那个世界，她还能继续存在吗？那个她存在、而这里不存在的世界？

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk27
: I’m not sure. Theoretically, yes. There are plenty of worlds out there where wishes walk among us.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。理论上可以。外面有很多世界，愿望造物就走在人群当中。

lines.en: : But I think the fact that Maya was capable of doing this in the first place is going to make it a lot harder for the gods to justify keeping her around, knowing they could be undermined at any minute.
lines.zh: : 但我觉得，Maya 一开始就能做到这种事，会让众神更难找到理由继续留着她——毕竟他们随时可能被架空。

lines.en: : Which isn’t even touching upon the fact that it’d be extremely unlikely for you to end up with Mom in a world where Maya continues to exist.
lines.zh: : 更不用说，在一个 Maya 继续存在的世界里，你最后能跟妈妈在一起的概率极低。

lines.en: : Me being here at all leads me to believe she can’t exist in any form in order for the future to properly unfold.
lines.zh: : 我能出现在这里这件事本身，就让我相信她不能以任何形式存在，否则未来就无法正常展开。

lines.en: : But there’s technically a chance you’re wrong, right?
lines.zh: : 但严格来说你也有可能是错的，对吧？

lines.en: : There’s technically a chance you could be elected as prime minister too. But that doesn’t mean it’s going to happen or that you should get your hopes up for it.
lines.zh: : 严格来说你也有可能被选为首相。但那不意味着它会发生，也不意味着你该对它抱有期待。

lines.en: : Himawari-
lines.zh: : Himawari——

lines.en: : Dad — I know you love her and I know you want to save her. You would have never wished for her at all if that wasn’t the case.
lines.zh: : 爸爸——我知道你爱她，我知道你想救她。如果不是这样，你根本一开始就不会许愿要她。

lines.en: : But I am concerned about you and Mom and that’s it.
lines.zh: : 但我只关心你和妈妈。仅此而已。

lines.en: : Saving Maya is beyond my capabilities and, frankly, beyond my desires as well. If I let myself get attached to others the way you do, I’d have never been chosen for this job in the first place.
lines.zh: : 救 Maya 超出了我的能力范围，坦白讲，也超出了我的意愿。如果我像你那样对别人产生依恋，我一开始就不会被选中做这份工作。

lines.en: : What about Sana then? You clearly care about her if there’s still a place for her in your dream world.
lines.zh: : 那 Sana 呢？如果在你的理想世界里还有她的一席之地，你显然是在乎她的。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk28

: Just because I wished for something doesn’t mean I have complete control over it. I just wanted a perfect little life with my parents where all three of us had everything we wanted. And Mom wanted Sana.
lines.zh: : 许愿了什么，不代表我就能完全掌控它。我只是想要一个完美的小日子，和爸爸妈妈一起，我们三个都拥有想要的一切。而妈妈想要 Sana。

lines.en: : I do like her. Mostly as an adult, though. She’s kind of...a lot at this age. And not in a good way.
lines.zh: : 我确实喜欢她。不过主要是成年版的她。这个年纪的她有点……太过了。而且不是好的那种过。

lines.en: if ayanesanabeach2 == True:
scene beachhimawalk29
: I actually posed as her on this very beach a few years ago and had an entire conversation with you. That’s obviously not something you’d remember, though.
lines.zh: : 几年前我还在这片沙滩上假扮过她，跟你完整聊了一整场。不过那种事你当然不可能记得。

lines.en: : I’m not exactly allowed to be a recurring figure in your life. Something about a “conflict of interest” or whatever. Little do they know, that’s exactly why I signed on. I’m so evil, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 严格来说，我不该在你的生活里反复出现。说什么「利益冲突」还是什么的。他们哪里知道，我签下这份工作正是为了这个。我是不是很坏？

lines.en: : You’ve appeared to me before?...
lines.zh: : 你以前出现过在我面前？...

lines.en: : Mhm. A bunch of times. Sometimes it’s just as a spectator, though.
lines.zh: : 嗯。好多次。不过有时候只是当个旁观者。

lines.en: : I don’t always need to be involved. It’s enough just to be near you.
lines.zh: : 我并不总是需要参与。光是待在你身边就够了。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk30
: I think my Sana impression might need some work, though. You saw through me pretty easily and I just looked weird and forceful. Probably because I had to flirt with my dad.
lines.zh: : 不过我的 Sana 模仿大概还得练练。你一眼就看穿了我，我只显得又怪又刻意。大概是因为我得跟自己的爸爸调情吧。

lines.en: : Did I know it was you?...Like, you?
lines.zh: : 我当时知道是你吗？……就是你本人？

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk31
: Nope.
lines.zh: : 不知道。

lines.en: : But maybe next time you will?
lines.zh: : 但也许下次你会知道？

lines.en: : Now, please excuse me while I reformat this gremlin.
lines.zh: : 好了，失陪一下，我要把这个小怪物格式化了。

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk32
Himawari places her hand on the back of Sana’s head and I need to force away what I can only call “suppressed PTSD” as I flash back to what happened in Aomori just a short while ago.
lines.zh: Himawari 把手放在 Sana 的后脑勺上，我不得不强行压下去那种只能称之为「被压抑的创伤后应激」的感觉——就在不久前，我闪回了在 Aomori 发生的事。

lines.en: And while I can’t imagine the image of her being broken down into pixels will soon (if ever) depart from my memory, I can make it less painful by superimposing her true self over it as that is one vision I won’t ever suppress.
lines.zh: 虽然我无法想象她被分解成像素的画面会很快（如果真会的话）从我的记忆里消失，但我可以让它不那么痛苦——把她真实的样子叠印在上面，因为那个影像我永远不会去压抑。

lines.en: : So do you, like...feel anything when you do that?
lines.zh: : 那么，你做这个的时候……有感觉到什么吗？

lines.en: : What — like physically? Or emotionally?
lines.zh: : 什么——身体上的？还是情感上的？

lines.en: : Uhh...both?
lines.zh: : 呃……都有？

lines.en: : Physically, it’s like a cross between a dull vibration and a static-shock effect. So pretty much how you’d expect it to feel based on looking at the result.
lines.zh: : 身体上，像是钝钝的震动和静电电击的混合。所以基本就是你看着结果能想象到的那种感觉。

lines.en: : Emotionally, it’s a little weirder. Like a person’s emotions, thoughts, and memories are flowing into you so you can properly quarantine them.
lines.zh: : 情感上就更怪一点。像是一个人的情绪、念头和记忆全都流进你身体里，好让你妥善地把它们隔离起来。

lines.en: : Sometimes it hurts, sometimes it doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 有时候会疼，有时候不会。

lines.en: : Does it hurt right now?
lines.zh: : 现在疼吗？

lines.en: : To be honest, I’m not sure it will ever hurt again after Aomori.
lines.zh: : 说实话，在 Aomori 之后，我不确定它还会不会再疼了。

lines.en: : You went back there again?
lines.zh: : 你又回那儿去了？

lines.en: scene beachhimawalk33
: Ah! Shi-chan! There you are!
lines.zh: : 啊！Shi 酱！你在这儿啊！
